Application Data.NAME: Military Surplus Supply Co.
Application Data.MAILING ADDRESS: 1234 Armory Way, Suite 100, Fort Knox, KY 40121-1234
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Military Surplus Supply Co. specializes in the retail sale of military surplus goods, including uniforms, tactical gear, camping equipment, and outdoor supplies. We source high-quality products directly from military contracts, ensuring our customers receive authentic merchandise. Our store caters to both military personnel and civilians, offering a unique selection of items for outdoor enthusiasts, survivalists, and collectors. Additionally, we provide expert advice on product use and care, fostering a knowledgeable shopping experience for all clientele.
